comment: The source checkouts the app builds against, by commit. scripts/sources resolves them (QEMU_IOS_DIR, USBMUXD_SOURCE_DIR, QEMU_BUILD_DIR override the paths); scripts/vendor builds both at their pinned commits, into a vendor directory keyed by this file. The emulator and usbmuxd ship together (usb-zlp <-> qemu-zlp): bump both lines in one commit.

qemu-ios.provides: contrib/export-guest-artifacts.sh (guest tools, tables, entitlements, headers, dylib); build_dir is the development build (the helper's dylib for Xcode and the checks), never the release's --qemu-build

usbmuxd.provides: the usbmuxd the bundle ships: real ZLPs after max-packet-multiple writes, 50 ms polling once idle for 1 s, complete EP0 control transfers across NAK pauses, per-transfer log lines only at -v -v, and both listeners on owner-only Unix sockets
